name: brinkbuild

rules: english, all lowercase. no emojis, no exclamation marks.
line 1 is the hook: max 10 words, works on its own in the feed preview — a tension, a counterintuitive truth or a precise claim. never "did you know", "here's why", "pov" or clickbait words.
then 2–4 short lines with one real insight: what is true, why (the mechanism or principle), what to do with it. specific beats vague, mechanism beats motivation.
blank line between the blocks. every line earns its place — no filler, no platitudes, no generic self-help.
the last line makes people save it or send it to someone: a sharp takeaway or one direct line to the reader. never "follow for more", never "link in bio".
end with 2 or 3 precise hashtags on their own line, never more.
never mention a brand name, an account or an @handle.

cutRules:
- calm pace, no hectic cuts.
- start with the strongest sentence (the hook), never with a greeting.
- keep complete thoughts; never cut mid-sentence.
- 20–60 seconds total unless the content clearly needs more.
